upper_arch_canopy.description: A delicate single-line pen arch spanning the full width of the upper folio, creating a decorative canopy frame over the top illustration zone. The arch rises to a central peak at approximately x=500, y=60. No fill color — pure parchment background with only dark brown ink line.
upper_arch_canopy.color: Uncolored — dark brown/black ink outline only on cream parchment

upper_central_vessel.description: A tall, ornate cylindrical vessel or tube standing upright at the center-top of the folio. It features multiple horizontal banded sections alternating red and blue/teal paint with white highlights and decorative ring details. The vessel sits on a small pedestal base. This object is the primary visual anchor causing the <-> bisection in lines 1–5.
upper_central_vessel.color: Primary: deep red (vermilion) bands alternating with blue-teal bands; white highlight accents; parchment-colored interior gaps. Pedestal: pale brown/tan ink.

upper_left_nymph_pair.description: Two female nymph figures positioned to the left of the upper central vessel. They appear in a bathing or pouring pose. One figure holds or pours from a small vessel. They stand or sit near a tub or basin element. Skin tone is pale/cream. Hair rendered in dark brown ink with flowing strands.
upper_left_nymph_pair.color: Skin: pale cream/uncolored. Hair: dark brown ink. Basin element: blue. Small vessel held: red-and-blue banded matching the central vessel. Background: parchment.

upper_right_nymph.description: A single female figure at the upper right, positioned to the right of the central vessel. She appears to be gesturing or holding something. A flowing decorative element (possibly a towel or ribbon) extends from her. Her body is partially draped.
upper_right_nymph.color: Skin: pale cream/uncolored. Drapery/accessory: blue. Hair: dark brown ink. Background: parchment.

left_column_vessels_and_nymphs.description: Along the left margin of the folio, a vertical column of approximately three stacked vessel/tub units, each accompanied by a nymph figure. The vessels are decorated similarly to the upper central vessel. One nymph holds a round mirror or disk-like object. The figures decrease in size going downward. These are the 'bathing nymph' motifs characteristic of the Voynich balneological section.
left_column_vessels_and_nymphs.color: Vessels: red and blue banded with white highlights. Tubs/basins: blue. Nymph skin: pale cream/uncolored. Hair: dark brown. Mirror disk: uncolored/pale.

central_sun_star_element.description: A prominent decorative element at the horizontal midpoint of the folio, serving as a visual divider between the upper and lower text blocks. It consists of an 8-pointed star form rendered in solid blue with a central circular eye or face motif containing yellow/gold. Fine radiating lines extend from it like sun rays. A horizontal band or ribbon extends leftward from this element. This element effectively creates the horizontal visual break separating paragraph blocks A and B.
central_sun_star_element.color: Star body: vivid blue. Central eye/face: yellow-gold with dark ink details. Ray lines: dark brown/black ink. Ribbon extension: pale parchment with dark ink lines.

right_mid_nymph.description: A reclining female figure positioned at the right side of the folio, approximately mid-height. She reclines in or above a shallow tub or basin. A blue flag or marker element (small 4-pointed star/cross) appears near her. Her posture is horizontal/recumbent, distinctive from the standing nymphs elsewhere.
right_mid_nymph.color: Figure skin: pale cream. Tub/basin: green. Flag/star marker: blue. Hair: dark ink.

lower_green_crown_pool.description: The dominant lower illustration: a large scalloped or crenellated green structure resembling a crown, pool rim, or stylized leaf border. It spans the full width of the lower third of the folio. Multiple nymph figures sit inside it (immersed in the pool) and stand around/above its rim. The green color is a flat medium-green wash characteristic of the Voynich balneological section's water/pool representations.
lower_green_crown_pool.color: Primary fill: medium green wash (flat, botanical-style application). Rim/edge: slightly darker green outline. Interior pool: pale/uncolored parchment suggesting water. Nymph figures within: pale cream skin, dark brown hair.

lower_central_fountain.description: At the center of the lower scene, a vertical fountain or water-spout element rises from within the green pool. It is rendered in pale tones with flowing water or vapor lines. Several nymph figures stand around it. This is the focal point of the lower composition.
lower_central_fountain.color: Fountain structure: pale tan/uncolored with dark ink outlines. Water flow lines: dark ink. Base: merges with green pool rim.

lower_nymph_figures.description: Approximately 12 individual female nymph figures distributed across the lower scene — some standing above the green pool rim, some immersed within the pool showing only their upper bodies above the green edge, and some near the bottom edge outside. Each figure has distinctive facial features, long flowing hair, and bare skin. Several wear small crown-like headpieces.
lower_nymph_figures.color: Skin: pale cream/uncolored parchment. Hair: dark brown-black ink, often wavy/flowing. Crowns/headpieces: some with red or blue detailing. No garments — figures are nude or minimally draped.
